architecture_summary: Modular React app. Pages in src/pages/. Shared components in src/components/. Tailwind CSS for styling. React Router for navigation. Vite build tool. No state management library (use React context for global state if needed).

tickets.title: Landing page skeleton from Stitch screen sentra_security_reinvented
tickets.description: Convert Stitch HTML/CSS to React component. Extract inline styles to Tailwind classes. Preserve exact layout, spacing, typography. Use semantic HTML5 tags. Mobile-first responsive.
acceptance_criteria: Pixel-perfect match to Stitch screen sentra_security_reinvented
All text content extracted to constants object at top of file
No hardcoded colors (use Tailwind config palette)

tickets.title: Shared component library from Stitch style guide
tickets.description: Extract reusable components (buttons, cards, typography, color palette) from style guide. Create src/components/ui/ directory. Each component gets own file. Use Tailwind for styling. Export all via src/components/ui/index.js.
acceptance_criteria: All components match Stitch style guide exactly
Storybook stories optional (ponytail: add when design system grows)

tickets.title: Component showcase page from Stitch screen component_showcase_buttons_cards
tickets.description: Build showcase page demonstrating all UI components. Use components from TASK-002. Page should match Stitch screen layout. Add interactive states (hover, focus) via Tailwind.
acceptance_criteria: All components from TASK-002 rendered with all variants

tickets.title: Tailwind config and global styles
tickets.description: Configure Tailwind. Extract color palette, typography, spacing from Stitch style guide. Add global styles (fonts, base styles) in src/index.css. Configure tailwind.config.js.
acceptance_criteria: All Stitch colors in Tailwind palette

tickets.title: App shell, navigation bar, and router wiring (src/App.jsx)
tickets.description: Create app shell. Add navigation bar (extract from Stitch screens if present, else minimal placeholder). Set up React Router. Configure routes for all pages (LandingPage, ComponentShowcase). Add 404 page. Ensure responsive layout.
acceptance_criteria: Router uses lazy loading (ponytail: add when app grows)
